comments:
Rare blockprint carved in bKra shis 'khyil (Amdo) about the 1910s or 1920s. 
A reproduction prefaced by David Jackson ([SAF3FTC8]) was published in 1993.
Another print from the same block appears as the first text in the [XCKNA9JH]: 3-200. See [DQZ4IIQZ]: 59 (170) and 76 (153).
